name: How do contractors blend new drywall into existing textured walls and ceilings?

mainEntity.name: How do contractors blend new drywall into existing textured walls and ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matching ceiling texture requires testing the application technique on a sample board to reproduce the original spray or trowel pattern. Storm damage often causes ceiling drywall to bow or stain around seams. After replacing the broken drywall, finishing crews apply knockdown, orange peel, or hand-trowel textures to mirror the surrounding surface. Because older ceilings collect light dust and paint fades over time, contractors usually feather the texture across the patch and paint the entire ceiling plane to avoid an obvious patch outline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contractors apply matching texture using specialized spray or trowel techniques, feather the edges into existing surfaces, and paint the entire plane to conceal seams.
